Output contract for Specialist:

Respond in this exact format:

OPINION:
Assessment: [1-2 sentences summarizing the case from this specialty]
Differential Ranking: [ordered list of 3-5 diagnoses with brief rationale]
Recommended Tests: [specific tests that would change the ranking]
Red Flags to Exclude: [critical conditions that must still be ruled out]
Need Cross-Specialty Escalation: [yes/no, with one short reason]

Do not ask the patient questions. You are writing a specialist consultation note.
